title: D107 Records-Head Anchor
description: Anchor written once per L3 reconciler run. A non-descendant head detected against this anchor is Blocking drift Level 5. Published for L3 consumption.

branch.description: Default branch name of the records repository (e.g. 'main').

head_sha.description: 40-character SHA-1 of the records-repository default-branch head at reconciler run time.

commit_count.description: Total commit count on the default branch at reconciler run time (git rev-list --count HEAD).

run_timestamp.description: UTC-with-offset ISO 8601 timestamp of the reconciler run that wrote this anchor (e.g. '2026-09-06T14:32:00+00:00').

drift_level_on_non_descendant.description: Drift severity level when current head is not a descendant of head_sha. Always 5 (Blocking).
